title: Thermal
look: A thermal camera view: false-colour heat from cold violet through magenta and orange to white-hot, a scale bar and crosshair.

doc.essence: What an infrared camera sees: not the character's colours but its warmth, mapped onto a false-colour scale, glowing hottest in the core of the body and cooling towards the edges, against a cold room.
doc.notIt: Not synthwave (no grid, no sun, heat gradients from the centre out), not soft-gradient (the colour ignores the palette and follows the heat scale), not neon (filled, no tubes).
doc.shapes: No outline: each part is a soft blob of heat, brightest in its middle.
doc.colour: Every area uses the same heat scale (violet, magenta, red, orange, yellow, white). The belly runs hottest, the body warm, dark parts and limbs cooler.
doc.eyes: Dark cool spots on the hot face, or white-hot where the eyes were light.
pitfalls: The palette is ignored by design: two mascots in this style differ only in shape.
The scale bar and crosshair sit in the corners and centre, never over the eyes.
